subject: COVID-19 School Safety and Student Testing Initiatives
overview: The committee reviewed school reopening safety protocols, specifically discussing rising COVID-19 community transmission, the pilot of rapid testing programs, and the return of high school seniors to in-person learning.

items.title: Routine Approvals
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the November 16 meeting as well as bills, payrolls, and fund transfers.

items.title: Communications Strategy Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Approved subcommittee reports regarding a revised kindergarten orientation timeline and plans to select a district-wide communication platform to assist parents and PTOs.

items.title: Behavioral Health and Special Education Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Received an update on trauma-informed school initiatives and pilot programs designed to foster friendships for students with disabilities in recreational and athletic settings.

items.title: Curriculum Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Approved a report detailing professional development for staff on disability awareness and plans to pilot an embedded disability awareness curriculum in early 2021.

items.title: COVID-19 Public Safety Concerns
items.summary: Staff from Roberts Elementary and representatives from the Medford Teachers Association requested a temporary shift to remote learning due to rising infection rates and staffing shortages caused by quarantines.

items.title: Superintendent's Update
items.summary: The superintendent introduced new student representatives and announced the staggered return dates for high school seniors beginning December 10.

items.title: COVID-19 Public Health and Testing Report
items.summary: Health officials reported that despite rising community transmission, no in-school transmission has been detected; the committee debated the necessity of publishing more granular data on close contacts and quarantines.

items.title: Abbott BinaxNOW Rapid Testing Pilot
items.summary: Health services presented a pilot program for rapid, 15-minute point-of-care COVID-19 testing for symptomatic individuals in schools to expedite isolation and contact tracing.

items.title: Responsive Classroom Update
items.summary: Staff reported on the district-wide implementation of the Responsive Classroom approach to build social-emotional consistency during remote and hybrid learning.

items.title: Updated Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan
items.summary: Approved an updated bullying prevention plan including new health education sequences; the document was referred to the Rules, Policy, and Equity Subcommittee for further refinement and summary creation.

items.title: Snow Day Policy Discussion
items.summary: The superintendent indicated that remote learning may be utilized on traditional snow days this year to maintain instructional consistency, depending on weather severity and power availability.

items.title: Superintendent Evaluation and Goal Setting
items.summary: Approved a resolution to complete the 2019-2020 superintendent evaluation and set 2020-2021 goals, with a revised completion target of early February.

items.title: Testing and Health App Adoption Report
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to provide participation data for the AlphaMed symptom checker and voluntary student COVID-19 testing by building.

items.title: Budget Hearing Schedule
items.summary: Approved a resolution requiring the administration to provide a schedule for the 2021-2022 budget hearings by late January 2021.

items.title: COVID-19 Grant Spending Report
items.summary: Approved an ad hoc report request for an itemized breakdown of COVID-related grant expenditures and remaining funds.
